title: Quirk living document header
description: The machine-readable header of a living document (intention, goal, roadmap, todo, plan, brief): what it is, who owns it, which exact head it observed, when it was last reviewed, when it must be reviewed again, and what it derives from. Parsed from the Markdown header block by scripts/validate_living_docs.py. A valid header proves shape and freshness, not that the content is true or done.

kind.description: intention: a strength turned into a direction; goal: an observable outcome with a measure; roadmap: now/next/later/done; todo: open/blocked/done tasks; plan and brief: the existing templates carrying this header.

status.description: candidate: written, not yet adopted; active: being worked; paused: deliberately parked; done: outcome observed; retired: no longer pursued. Only candidate, active, and paused documents can go stale.

observed_head.description: The full commit SHA of the repository state this document describes. Any later head may invalidate it; re-observe and bump Reviewed when it changes materially.

derived_from.description: Lineage: repository-relative paths or URLs of the upstream documents or evidence this one was derived from (a strength's receipt, an intention, a goal, a brief). At least one entry; every repository-relative path must exist inside the checkout (no absolute paths, no traversal outside the repository).
